_note: Selection of verses from Psalm 102 sung as the First Typical Antiphon at the Liturgy. The base liturgy-fixed.json carries the full 10-verse selection, and the `oca` overlay carries it in traditional register; parishes that sing a genuine short form override the verses array. NOTE: `_target.path` is a whole-array replacement — a variant here REPLACES the canonical verses, it cannot select a subset of them. A short form authored from a parish folder must therefore be checked against what is actually sung, not against what the folder prints; see the deprecation note on `short-4-verse`.

variants.label: Short form (4 verses)
variants._deprecation_note: Do not pick. Lossy extraction, retired 2026-07-29. This was transcribed from the Tyler service folder on 2026-06-19 as if it were the whole antiphon, but it jumps from the opening (Ps 102:1-2) straight to Ps 102:22, dropping vv. 3-9 and 19-21. Because _target is a whole-array replacement, pinning it deleted the canonical verses rather than selecting from them — the parish reported the antiphon rendering short at Liturgy on 2026-07-26. Kept resolvable per CONTRACT.md rule 2; Tyler's pick row was removed so the parish inherits the full `oca` overlay text.

_provenance.source_citation: St. John of Damascus (Tyler) parish service folder
